extracted.intended_audience: general users who need to convert lengths between centimeters and feet (e.g., people checking heights, measurements, or using an online converter)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and reference information for converting lengths from centimeters (cm) to feet (ft), including definitions, the conversion formula, an example calculation, and a conversion table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a foot (canonical length)
rubrics_metrics.description: A foot is defined as 0.3048 of a meter, so 30.48 centimeters equal one feet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This fixed definition (1 ft = 0.3048 m = 30.48 cm) is the basis for converting between metric and imperial lengths; use it for exact conversions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a centimeter
rubrics_metrics.description: The centimeter is part of the metric system; a centimeter is defined as 1/100 of a meter, so 1 cm = 0.01 m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the meter is defined by the distance light travels in vacuum in a fraction of a second, this yields an exact relation between cm and SI base units to use in conversions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion formula (cm to ft)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To convert a measurement given in centimeters to feet, divide the centimeter value by 30.48. This yields feet in decimal form. The page provides a free online converter implementing this formula.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion example and calculation practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Example: convert 185 cm to feet. Calculation: 185 cm / 30.48 = 6.069554 ft. End result: 185 cm is equal to 6.069554 ft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the formula and show intermediate calculation; the page demonstrates reporting both full-precision decimal and a rounded value (185 cm to feet is 6.06) and interprets decimal feet as approximate feet+inches (≈6 ft 1 in).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation and symbols for units
rubrics_metrics.description: The symbol for centimeters is 'cm', while 'ft' is used for feet. Sometimes a single quote does the same job, e.g. 6' tall means 6 feet tall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'cm' and 'ft' for clarity in technical contexts; the single-quote shorthand is common in informal contexts to denote feet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextual guidance on unit usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Both feet and centimeters are units for measuring length. Feet are used to measure small distances and remain preferred in the US for commerce, engineering and standardization; centimeters (metric) are adopted in most other countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose units based on customary practice and application domain (e.g., human height, construction, architecture). The page also notes historical variability of the foot but emphasizes the modern standardized definition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lookup/reference via conversion table
rubrics_metrics.description: A cm to ft conversion table lists common cm values and their ft equivalents (e.g., 100 cm = 3.280840 ft, 200 cm = 6.561680 ft, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the table for quick reference to common conversions or to verify calculator results; table values are given to six decimal places for precision.
